Dooku / Darth Tyranus: Comic Vine respect thread (ShootingNova), read 2026-10-17
Part 1 (physical + lightsaber): https://comicvine.gamespot.com/profile/shootingnova/blog/respect-count-dooku-part-1/95276/
Part 2 (Force powers): https://comicvine.gamespot.com/forums/battles-7/count-dookudarth-tyranus-respect-thread-part-2-1871928/
LABEL CAVEAT: ShootingNova tags some items "Canon:". Several of those are Legends novelizations (AOTC novel by R.A. Salvatore, AOTC Junior Novelization, ROTS novel by Stover) that he tagged canon because the film event is canon. Below, LEGENDS = Legends prose/comics/reference; CANON = Disney-canon works (TCW TV, Dark Disciple, Son of Dathomir, Fact File Relaunched, starwars.com databank). Image/video-only items with no text are listed as UNVERIFIED (scan or clip, not checked). No chapter numbers are given in the thread (GAP). Count only quoted source text, not ShootingNova's captions.

== LIGHTSABER / PHYSICAL (Part 1) ==
LEGENDS quoted text:
- Yoda: Dark Rendezvous (Sean Stewart): "Among the other Jedi, perhaps only Mace Windu would have been his equal on neutral ground: but here on Vjun, steeped in the dark side, his bladework was malice made visible." Also "The Count's blade was quick as a viper striking." Duel: Dooku tags Yoda twice (once off a distraction, Whirry thrown out the window), then in fair blade-to-blade "Slowly, slowly, Dooku gave way." Dooku, sweating, admits "There was always a chance you could overpower me," and escapes by dropping an orbital missile on the chateau. RESULT: Yoda > Dooku on blades, Dooku escapes by tactic.
- Dark Rendezvous: Dooku "wore his eighty-three standard years better than most humans half his age... superb physical shape."
- Dark Rendezvous (Qui-Gon's voice): "He is a fencer. Leverage, position, advantage, they are as natural to him as breathing."
- Labyrinth of Evil (James Luceno): Dooku had "become the Temple's most agile swordmaster and instructor." "consummate planner, consummate duelist." Sith as "paranormally strong and quick." Grievous: "There had been moments during the extensive combat sessions when even Dooku had been hard-pressed to outduel the cyborg" (so Dooku usually wins their spars). Dooku disarms two MagnaGuards and puts his blade tip "a millimeter from Grievous's death-helmeted visage." Sidious saw Dooku as "a true accomplice - an equal from the other camp... a master duelist" (vs Maul, Ventress, Grievous as minions).
- AOTC novelization (Salvatore, LEGENDS): "Dooku held strong, though, his red blade parrying brilliantly, each block backed by the power of the Force, or else Yoda's strikes would have driven right through." Yoda's blade "began to move out, just a bit, forcing Dooku back"; Dooku escapes by dropping a crane on Obi-Wan and Anakin. "Dooku retracted impossibly fast."
- AOTC Junior Novelization (LEGENDS): Jocasta Nu via Obi-Wan: "With a lightsaber, in the old style of fencing, he had no match." "his lightsaber seemed to be everywhere."
- ROTS novelization (Stover, LEGENDS): spinning side-stamp "folded Skywalker in half," wheel-kick to Kenobi's chin "with a crack like the report of a huge-bore slugthrower." "blades flashing faster than the eye could see." "drawing once more upon the certain knowledge of his personal invincibility... the weight of his years dropped away."
- ROTS Junior Novelization (LEGENDS): "Even with both Anakin and Obi-Wan pressing him, he seemed at ease... Dooku blocked them all." "The dark side would keep Dooku going for as long as he needed."
- Legacy of the Jedi (Jude Watson): 12-year-old Dooku's "lightsaber a blur." Obi-Wan after Geonosis: "He had never come up against something that had completely overpowered him. Even meeting the Sith Lord who had killed Qui-Gon had not been the same." (Dooku > Maul per Obi-Wan's experience.)
- Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader (Luceno): "Only Dooku, Asajj Ventress, and Obi-Wan had been good enough with a blade to injure him."
- Darth Plagueis (Luceno): "known to be one of the Order's most skilled duelists."
- Power of the Jedi Sourcebook: "In the history of the Jedi Order, only two opponents ever overcame [Mace Windu] in battle. One was Master Yoda... The other was former Master Dooku." Same claim in the old Mace databank and SW Miniatures ROTS preview.
- The Clone Wars: Lightsaber Duels (Wii game, 2008; this is Clone Wars-branded, treat as CANON-adjacent/game): Dooku to Mace: "You were never able to defeat me at the Jedi Temple, and you won't defeat me now." Game bio: "His mastery of the Makashi Lightsaber form is unmatched."
- Reference accolades (LEGENDS-era): Insider #109 "Only Masters Yoda and Mace Windu were considered to be on equal terms with him"; Starships & Vehicles #48 "eclipsed only by Mace Windu and Yoda himself"; Fact File #60 "second only to Master Yoda"; Insider #69 (Dooku vs Maul) "Count Dooku is more skillful than Maul... Dooku countered Kenobi's moves almost effortlessly"; Panel-to-Panel Vol 1 "if anything deadlier than Maul."
- Nick Gillard (stunt coordinator, out-of-universe): "Dooku & Maul are 8, but there is a huge difference inside the numbers themselves." Hayden/Anakin ROTS level 9 with Yoda and Sidious; "Mace is eight, bordering on nine." Out-of-universe; low weight. [panel: panels/dooku/dooku-canon-dookus-lightsaber-skills-better-anything-seen-1.png]
- Fact File #18 (Relaunched; CANON-era reference): "he was never fully bested... He achieved the near impossible by wounding Master Yoda during a fight on Vjun."
- Fact File #34 (Relaunched): "Yoda and Dooku were almost equals, with the little Jedi Master having perhaps a slight edge." [panel: panels/dooku/dooku-feats-1.png]
UNVERIFIED (image/clip only): Dooku humbles Sora Bulq and Tholme (Republic comics; takes Tholme's eye); outduels pre-prime Quinlan Vos; duels Mace evenly until MagnaGuards throw Mace off a cliff (Republic: Obsession? per earlier notes); Dooku "defeats Yoda" by feigning weakness then lightning (Clone Wars Tartakovsky micro-series, canon-era-Legends: shown as gallery only); falls from a great height unharmed. [panel: panels/dooku/dooku-count-easily-outduels-pre-prime-quinlan-vos-1.jpg; panels/dooku/dooku-count-easily-outduels-pre-prime-quinlan-vos-2.jpg; panels/dooku/dooku-count-easily-outduels-pre-prime-quinlan-vos-3.jpg; panels/dooku/dooku-dooku-duels-evenly-mace-windu-period-time-1.jpg; panels/dooku/dooku-dooku-duels-evenly-mace-windu-period-time-2.jpg]
CANON (labeled, separate): Dark Disciple (Christie Golden) feats vs Vos and Ventress ("inhuman strength," Vos "didn't have much trouble parrying"); TCW clips vs Ventress, Savage, Nightsisters while drugged, Anakin bladelocks; Son of Dathomir #4 Sidious to Talzin: "You control Dooku's body, but you possess none of his skill."

== FORCE POWERS (Part 2) ==
LEGENDS quoted text:
- Dark Rendezvous: Yoda: "the strongest student, yes? Wisest? Most learned in the ways of the Force?... Best of all, Dooku would be!... Our great failure." Thame Cerulian: "the most gifted Padawan he ever saw." Dooku's pain-torture of Ventress with a finger tap ("Like sharp stones in your throat and chest"); a shelf of holocrons.
- AOTC novelization: Dooku "clutched up at the ceiling, breaking free great blocks" at Yoda, which Yoda brushes aside. Lightning: "Yoda caught it in his own hand and turned it aside, but far from easily." Push "as solid as any stone wall" plus lightning on Anakin.
- ROTS novelization: "Until he became the axis of the Universe... The dark side didn't bring him to the center of the universe. It made him the center." Perceives Palpatine as "an event horizon... A black hole of the Force." A flick that sends Kenobi crashing; accelerates Kenobi's fall "like a missile" so the permacrete buckles. Chairs and the situation table slammed into Anakin while one-hand binding Obi-Wan. "Once a great Jedi master, now an even greater Lord of the Sith... a dark colossus bestriding the galaxy."
- Jedi Quest: The Final Showdown (Jude Watson): Dooku (unseen "Sith") lifts Anakin "like a doll"; Anakin: "I felt the Force come at me like an autoblaster cannon." Hurls corroded vehicles and a cruiser, mashes them into a wall of metal. Heart stun on Auben ("Her heart just stopped beating"). Dark energy trap Anakin can't break ("He had met a power greater than his"). Korriban zombies (Sith sorcery). Illusions of Sith Lords, Shmi, Qui-Gon that fade when he withdraws. Lightning barrier.
- Labyrinth of Evil: Quey'tek concealment master; Yoda "hadn't had a sense of that danger until he had fought Dooku on Geonosis."
- Darth Plagueis (Luceno, via comment #19 the_wspanialy): Plagueis considered Dooku possible "insurance" if he lost Sidious; "Already strong in the Force, trained in combat and a diplomat... might have made for a powerful partner." Palpatine held back revealing himself because "Dooku was strong in the Force."
- Outbound Flight (Zahn): "a master of the Dark Side like Lord Tyranus."
- Precipice (short story, Legends): Dooku's mind-rip on a restrained, electrocuted Obi-Wan ("rooting through his memories"), Obi-Wan resists recruitment at the end.
- Reference: Insider #109 "near unrivalled knowledge of the Force"; Insider #113 "would have been a Master on a par with Yoda had he not abandoned the Order"; Figurine Collection #3 "Only a Jedi Master as powerful as Yoda could survive such an attack"; Fact File #116 Sith holocron "enhanced his own powers"; New Essential Chronology: guided by Ulic Qel-Droma's ghost to excavate the Force Harvester (Dark Reaper) (implies drain resistance; inference, not stated).
- Tartakovsky (Clone Wars micro-series commentary, out-of-universe): "almost as powerful as Yoda himself." George Lucas (AOTC commentary): Yoda and Dooku "equal to each other" in the Force at Geonosis (out-of-universe; film canon).
UNVERIFIED (image/clip only): Force barrier vs Ventress's repulse and vs Mace's Force wave (Republic comics, unnamed issues); controls a krayt dragon; kills Komari Vosa with choke (Clone Wars micro-series / Republic); heals himself of the Karatos plague (Republic).
CANON (labeled): TCW lightning on Maul and Nightbrothers; Witches of the Mist (Savage: "How can one defend against such power?"; "He's too... powerful"); Dark Disciple lightning that kills Ventress after he's shot; Son of Dathomir: assists Sidious vs Talzin; Barlow: revived Maul's "power isn't on... Count Dooku's level."
Comment notes (opinion): Greysentinel365 says the AOTC "fought evenly" quotes shouldn't count (Yoda was clearly winning); noobsnowman/Greysentinel on Filoni's "thirty pirates" quote as Canon-vs-EU nerf.
